devices.name: Effective order 2 in the 7/8 architecture (h = r/2): derivation items only
devices.evidence: map section 6 item 1; narrowed after round 6 (lesson 1) to derivation items. Closed parts: re-expression of the same probe (Lemma U, two referees; row Z15b); abelian families (row Z22; abstract-family statement ARGUED); double covers through local data (row Z23, claim narrowed by its referee); probes of higher degree in the target (row Z15c); long marks at h = 3 as an input weaker than GRH (row Z26); the sextic probe as a route below abscissa 2/3 (normaliser H_eta, row Z24, two referees). Left open: (a) the uncompensated high side derived from manuscript (12.5)/(16.1) with the normaliser kept; (b) the compensated principal signal below Re s = 3/5; (c) whether any model vertex with 1 < h <= 3 exists. Requirement added: the normaliser of the probe has no zeros in Re s > 1/2

devices.name: Sections of the prime chain on a Reinhardt (Laurent) shell around the critical torus, gamma one-port included
devices.evidence: lane c7-laurent-shell-gamma-section (round 7, one referee): the first-moment bracket has no forced sign for zeta or for DH on the shell or with the gamma term; every statement holds for DH; the limit step is void in measure form and is the height-coupled reserve inequality of g-passive-cascade in formula form. Map rows under Q12/Q22 owed. Not covered: a section with P(t) growing like a power of t

devices.name: Prop. 2.1 probe with signal constant h > 1 in F_q[T] (region lx < l), where the Riemann hypothesis is a theorem
devices.evidence: lane c7-ff-order2-vertex-exact (round 7, one referee; q = 7, 13, N <= 4): base probe at lx < l re-expresses blocks with h < 1; the uncompensated marked probe has h > 1 where RH holds, but its low input (diagonal-level row bound) contains the squared signal and fails for the Moebius-twisted weight. Round 8 (c8-ek-ff-reflected-rows-exact, one referee): compensated probe (12.5) computed at dual length 0: h > 1 survives, the rescaled term is about q^(-lam) of the marked signal, the low input is unchanged. Left open: reflected completed rows; threshold test undecided at N <= 4. Constraint from row Z24: the normaliser must have no zeros in Re s > 1/2

devices.name: (E-K): mean square of reflected marked theta rows for the probe vector itself, dual longer than the row set
devices.evidence: named by c7-probe-format-h-cap (one referee; second referee of Theorem K and Lemma A in push/c8-repair-engine-map-r7/c7-probe-format-h-cap/REFEREE2.md). Not an operator-norm statement: every blockwise l2-l2 estimate of the reflected rows is at or above the K-branch (Hilbert-Schmidt). Under test in round 8 (c8-ek-ff-reflected-rows-exact, c8-ek-theta-second-moment-formula). Model value with the polar term kept: 31/36, no vertex with h > 1 (first referee E2); form of the hypothesis corrected by first referee E3. Ceiling 2/3 from row Z24. Round 8 (state kept open, narrowed; one referee each): c8-ek-theta-second-moment-formula: the row mean square equals X D + X Sum_k F_k exactly, F_k bilinear in Moebius sums over the order-6 twist family of the target, so (E-K) is a mean value of 1/L over a family containing the target (zero-free type; holds for X >= ZP under GRH for the family, outline only); c8-ek-ff-reflected-rows-exact: in F_q[T] row energy = diagonal + squared signal, targets not separated from random vectors (reflected completed rows not run). Left open: the window Z/P < X < ZP (31/36 vertex); the mean value (MV6) of 1/L over the order-6 family for the Moebius vector

devices.name: (E-H): cancellation over non-principal rows below the floor-class high bound
devices.evidence: named by c7-probe-format-h-cap; values corrected by its referee (E1: 4/5 with G = 0, 13/15 with the polar term kept, 1 - 2/r only in the three-input model). Round 8, c8-eh-nonprincipal-row-cancellation (state kept open: the referee does not hold the circularity headline): NP = I - I_1 exactly, so a bound on NP is necessary and sufficient for the conclusion given the low estimate (necessity, not circularity); termwise and norm treatments closed in the model (13/15; 31/36 with E-K); row cancellation in F_q[T] at r <= 4 is present for every weight, random non-multiplicative included. Left open: a target-specific treatment. Ceiling 2/3 from row Z24

devices.name: Bridge (spinor square-root) form built from one completed probe row B_m
devices.evidence: closed by c8-single-row-bridge-crossing (round 8, one referee, holds with five wording corrections): a theta row is T = L0 D with L0 = L(3s - 1/2, psi); the row axis Re s = 1/2 is Re w = 1 for L0 (1/6 in s from its own axis), so the bridge of T is blind to zeros of L0; the bridge of D reads them as an identity with no sign; the target enters one row only as a coefficient twist. Kubota-Patterson normalisation in bridge language. Map row owed

devices.name: Mechanism of the 2026 Landau-Siegel claim (conductor-aspect family of real characters)
devices.evidence: lane c7-landau-siegel-device-read (round 7, one referee; Lean tree read as text, not compiled): interpolation determinant over a box in Z[sqrt d, sqrt 2] with Frobenius-congruence divisibility against the prime bias of a real zero. Floor: real zeros with 1 - beta <= c/log q only; empty to the left; no height-aspect form (n^(-it) is control U). THIN and the Liouville twist fail at S4/S5. The statement itself follows from the compiled Dirichlet 7/8 theorem
